title: Full observation criteria prompts
details: NVQ video observations now show the full AC wording while recording instead of visually truncating it to two lines
KSB video observations now use the exact full KSB descriptions as the main observation prompt rather than the shorter generated opportunity wording
KSB prompts are clearly labelled Knowledge · theory, Skill · practical or Behaviour so the assessor can immediately see what kind of evidence is being considered
Long criteria remain readable on phone in a scrollable prompt area without changing the continuous recording, competence taps, LO actions or evidence timestamps
Witness video testimony keeps its witness cue as a secondary prompt while the exact mapped criteria remain primary
